description: World Pulse Daily Tech and Money Briefing. What moved in tech and money today, from public catalogues that only ever show *today*. Lilambd writes them down every day, so they become a history. Routes: /fx (base, to, amount, date); /days (limit); /feeds; /today (date); /search (q*, feed, from, to, history, limit, offset); /changes (since, date, feed, kind, type, min_change_pct, limit, offset); /briefing (date); /feeds/{feed} (date, kind, q, sort, limit, offset); /feeds/{feed}/history (key, q, kind, from, to, limit, offset). Paid $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /fx, /days, /feeds, /today, /search, /changes, /briefing, /feeds/{feed}, /feeds/{feed}/history. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: pulse
